# Oussama Ezitouni — Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Portfolio of Oussama Ezitouni, a Morocco-based (Kenitra / Rabat) senior
> full-stack software engineer, DevOps architect, and technical lead with 3+
> years building scalable web applications. Dual expertise across the JavaScript
> (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and PHP (Symfony, Laravel) ecosystems.
> Co-founder of the GoToDev software agency.

Contact: ezitounioussama@gmail.com
Location: Kenitra / Rabat, Morocco
Languages: Arabic (native), English (C1), French (B2)

## About

Results-driven senior full-stack engineer who owns the full SDLC — from
requirements and system design to production deployment and performance
optimization. Started in the backend and moved into creating fast, expressive
frontend and 3D web experiences. Leads technical teams, mentors engineers, and
drives DevOps transformation.

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer & Technical Lead — Intelcia Tech, Rabat (2023–present).
  React / Next.js 15 / TypeScript frontends (40% perf gains, 10x traffic);
  PHP (Symfony, PRADO) + Node.js (NestJS, Fastify) backends and microservices;
  Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD; mentors 5+ engineers.
- Co-Founder, Lead Architect & Full-Stack Engineer — GoToDev / gotodev.ma
  (2022–present). 12+ web & mobile apps. Built Nlivrilik (real-time last-mile
  logistics). Delivered Aksam Assurance, Paylik, HoussniJob, Ibn Tofail
  University, Jadara Foundation. Maintains the gotodev CLI.
- Data Science Instructor — GoMyCode, Rabat (2023–2024). Python, Pandas,
  Scikit-learn, predictive modeling.
